day_shape: 49 items: Jerusalem Post reports Iranian hackers shut a UK power plant for four days in late July, Iran denounces new US sanctions plans, Pezeshkian frames wartime resilience on Government Week, IDF strikes in Deir al-Balah and southern Syria; nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Alleged Iranian cyberattack on UK power plant
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported that Iranian regime-affiliated hackers shut down a British power plant for four days in late July in what it described as an unprecedented cyberattack. The report came alongside coverage of Iran denouncing new US sanctions plans that Trump warned could hit trading partners including China.

threads.label: Pezeshkian Government Week messaging
threads.summary: IRIB carried Pezeshkian's Government Week remarks casting Iran as having withstood an 'all-out economic, military and security war' and rejecting comparisons to Venezuela, with a shrine visit to renew covenant with Khomeini's ideals. Defa Press quoted the president saying national cohesion had 'astonished the world.'

threads.label: IDF strikes in Gaza and southern Syria
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Hamas Deir al-Balah battalion company commander Sharif al-Hasanat in a strike in central Gaza, citing his role in restoring tunnel infrastructure. The military also confirmed a strike in Beit Jinn, southern Syria against an operative it said was in final stages of preparing an attack.

threads.label: Iranian military posture and Gulf signalling
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Iranian state TV aired footage of armed forces chief Ali Abdollahi at an underground ballistic missile site claiming sharply increased production, and said Iran had granted Iraqi oil tankers Hormuz passage. Khamenei's office republished the Supreme Leader's line that foreigners in the Persian Gulf belong 'at the bottom of its waters.'

threads.label: Internal Iranian political and economic strains
threads.summary: Iran International reported IRGC commander Ahmad Vahidi backed state broadcaster IRIB against criticism from Pezeshkian and Speaker Ghalibaf, and said Mojtaba Khamenei has not appeared publicly while officials govern in his name. A separate Iran International piece said the central bank governor denies hyperinflation while a Tehran economist argues it has arrived.

events.title_en: Pezeshkian: The cohesion of the Iranian nation has astonished the world
events.summary_en: Pezeshkian: The cohesion of the Iranian nation has astonished the world. The President said: As long as we have life in our bodies, we will serve our dear people and strive to improve their lives, their wellbeing and the country's future, and to overcome these crises with strength. Enemies' assumption was that with the pressures and measures they were taking, Iran would collapse, but not only did this not happen, the power and cohesion of the Iranian nation astonished the world. Analysts cannot easily explain how this nation, inspired by the path and ideals of the Imam and the martyrs, stood firm against these pressures. Our dear people truly showed their mettle.

events.title_en: Sardar Kermani-Asd warns of accidents in Shahrivar; travel management is necessary
events.summary_en: Sardar Kermani-Asd, Commander of the National Highway Traffic Police, warns of accidents in Shahrivar; travel management is necessary. Road fatalities in Shahrivar of last year were approximately 1,600 people, accounting for more than 10 to 11 per cent of the year's total fatalities; this month requires special travel management. Police have implemented special traffic plans including the expansion of visible and unmarked patrol teams with private vehicles. Due to the vastness of the areas and the inability to provide complete coverage, the capacity of neighbouring provinces and police stations has also been utilised.

events.title_en: Gharibabadi: Continued supply of weapons and any support for the Zionist regime is a conscious choice by London and Paris for cooperation and participation in the crimes of the Zionist regime
events.summary_en: Gharibabadi: Continued supply of weapons and any support for the Zionist regime is a conscious choice by London and Paris for cooperation and participation in the crimes of the Zionist regime. Kazem Gharibabadi, Deputy for Legal and International Affairs at the Foreign Ministry, said: More than a hundred veteran British and French diplomats warned their governments that the policy of the Zionist regime is heading towards 'ethnic cleansing' and 'erasure of Palestine'. They called for practical action by London and Paris to stop weapon transfers, ban trade with settlements and implement the decisions of The Hague courts. London and Paris should not hide behind the phrase 'expressing concern' about this situation; the continuation of weapon supplies and any support for the regime is a conscious choice.

events.summary_en: Pezeshkian: Economic war requires universal participation. events.title_en: Friday Imam of Baghdad: Continued support from Iraq's Marja for the resistance movement's weapons; the condition for weapon monopoly is the expulsion of the occupiers
events.summary_en: Friday Imam of Baghdad: Continued support from Iraq's Marja for the resistance movement's weapons; the condition for weapon monopoly is the expulsion of the occupiers. Ayatollah Sayed Yaseen Mousawi, in an interview with Defapress, said: Efforts to restrict the resistance movement's weapons are influenced by pressure from American occupiers to deprive Iraq of its defensive power. The resistance movement's weapons are weapons that have been legally permitted and are weapons for the protection of religion and its foundations and believers, and for the defence of Islam's sanctity and the preservation of the country's independence and its servants. The Hashd al-Shaabi's weapons continue to fulfil their religious and national role and their objectives have not been completed and the obligation for them remains in force. Just as the Marja's position in support of Hashd al-Shaabi is without compromise.

events.title_en: Seyyed Hassan Khomeini: We have passed through a glorious war; the role of our armed forces was unparalleled
events.summary_en: Seyyed Hassan Khomeini: We have passed through a glorious war; the role of our armed forces was unparalleled. Custodian of the Holy Shrine of Imam Khomeini: We have passed through a glorious war; the role of our armed forces was unparalleled. Future generations will speak of what soldiers, IRGC personnel, Basij members and police forces accomplished over these forty days, just as they have already spoken of it. Friends in government also played an unparalleled role that has been less remarked upon. The pressure placed on the country from every direction was no small matter; at least in our region, a tenth of this pressure could destroy governments. They wanted to destroy the Islamic Republic system; but it became stronger.

events.summary_en: Support package for housing of the deprived has been announced. Farhadizadeh, Director General of the Office of Housing Planning and Monitoring: Based on recent decisions, assistance to low-income deciles and beneficiaries of support institutions will be implemented as a special package. The Ministry of Roads and Urbanisation will provide assistance of up to 400 million tomans per individual. The Budget and Planning Organisation has also allocated funds of up to 8 billion tomans per year and 300 million tomans per person for this purpose. Low-interest loans with a fee of 5 per cent have been considered for housing projects for the deprived in cities.

events.summary_en: Crossed the 30 billion toman mark 21 times in 3 months and 3 days; record-breaking in retail trading value; shares became historical. Statistical data from the stock market supervision management of the Securities and Exchange Organisation shows that the value of retail trading in shares and equity funds since the reopening of the stock market, from 29 Ordibehesht to 31 Mordad 1405, has crossed the 30 billion toman mark a total of 21 times. The data shows that before the stock market's reopening on 29 Ordibehesht this year, the value of retail trading in shares throughout the history of stock market activity had only crossed the 30 billion toman mark on 3 business days; once on 18 Tir 1399 and twice in Dey 1404.

This operation is significant in that it demonstrates a combination of intelligence gathering by a manned aircraft and sustained drone activity. The TB-001 can be used for reconnaissance missions and, if necessary, to provide support for offensive operations around the Ryukyu Islands strategic chain.

events.title_en: Inscription | The mission of the Iranian nation in continuation of the path of the Great Khomeini and the beloved Khamenei. An excerpt from the message of His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, the Supreme Leader of the Revolution: in the words of the martyred leader of the highest rank, the mighty hand that could set the vast ocean of the nation into turmoil was the steely personality, trusting heart and sword-like tongue of the Great Imam and Khomeini who was able to bring millions of people to the field, keep them in the field and teach them the direction of movement. And certainly another example of this kind of influence is that of the beloved Khamenei himself, who took steps in the path of his worthy predecessors and for nearly four decades has led the revolution and the Islamic system, with trust in youth and deepening...

events.title: The IDF confirms carrying out a strike in southern Syria a short while ago, saying it targeted a terror operative "who advanced terror attacks in final stages of preparation." "The terrorist's activity posed an immediate threat to our forces," the military says. Syrian media reported that the strike in Beit Jinn injured one person.
events.summary:
The IDF confirms carrying out a strike in southern Syria a short while ago, saying it targeted a terror operative "who advanced terror attacks in final stages of preparation."

"The terrorist's activity posed an immediate threat to our forces," the military says.

Syrian media reported that the strike in Beit Jinn injured one person.Emanuel (Mannie) Fabian (@manniefabian)Syrian media reports one injured in an Israeli drone strike in the country's south a short while ago.

The local Sham FM radio says the strike hit a car in the town of Beit Jinn, around 10 kilometers from the Israeli border.—
